label: Parity history bound
title: Two steps of history are always enough under neighbor-parity coarse-graining
kind: Finite certificate proving a history bound for every ring size, with an exhaustive check at unvisited rings
summary: A local check on admissible 8-words, with a stated lemma, proves that every elementary rule has refinement depth at most 2 under neighbor parity on every ring; exactly eight rules need the second step, each already on the 5-cell ring; rings 7, 9, 11 and 14 reproduce the certified depths exactly.
takeaway: The memory cost of this coarse-graining contract is a theorem: at most two steps for any rule, one step for all but eight. The fifth unit's post-hoc observation is now certified.
